description.en: Withdraw cash from your own account at your branch counter.
description.ta: உங்கள் கிளைக் கவுண்டரில் உங்கள் கணக்கிலிருந்து பணம் எடுக்க.
description.hi: अपनी शाखा के काउंटर से अपने खाते से नकद निकालें।
description.or: ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଶାଖା କାଉଣ୍ଟରରୁ ନିଜ ଖାତାରୁ ନଗଦ ଉଠାନ୍ତୁ।

submit_note: Withdrawal slips usually work only for the account holder at the home branch. Sign exactly as in the bank's records and carry your passbook.

question.en: How much money do you want to withdraw?

fields.explain: Write the amount in figures. The amount in words is filled in for you below - it must match the figures exactly.

question.en: What date are you withdrawing on? (say 'today' if it's today)

fields.explain: The date you hand the slip to the cashier.

documents: An ID proof, in case the branch asks
